rongmei.title: Kalvary khou zauzian lou mei tei

lines: 1. Kalvary khou zauzian loumei tei.
Lik khap kan diu kandi nam ru khou hei,
Nang rui khan patloumei guai hei,
Theimei rianra pui bam khou bam.
He! Poubaomei nang tigun daimei zauzian rui.
Ndao khap diu zaat guai nakhou.
Meiguai lungning paap khou maan ngam
Nangzan nthanmei thuan ku kandiu.
2. Ai rui rianra rian riu bam khou hei,
Thou cho, poubaomei ata kanlou khang?
Kandi khou hei nangzan din khang,
Nkha loudiu khang mei makge.
3. Kandi nkhuai mei muang zing meikum.
Zing guang e poubaomei alung khou hei,
Tigaan lou o nang tikgun rui,
Alungh mun kum ma puang datni.
4. Nang ta ninga kap be Poubaomei,
Nzianmei guai tingsaeng lung nipui ram,
Kap bammei hei tabui nung rui,
Neihla mikdui phui datni cho.?
